product.lineage: Popeye replacement judgment engine with a Scope-inspired investigation shell

adapted: Kubernetes ownership and declared relationships instead of host-probe discovery
Kubernetes watches and revisioned snapshots instead of probe streams
explicit evidence tier, freshness, confidence, and coverage
rejected: host PID, host network, runtime socket, or debugfs access
terminal, delete, scale, and container lifecycle controls
declared relationships presented as observed traffic

slices.name: API graph baseline
capabilities: provider-neutral graph contract and stable object identity
semantic views, graph and table modes, search, filters, and drill-down
URL-restorable selection and an unbounded, pannable graph canvas

modes.offline: Embed the complete deterministic graph and contextual navigation in the self-contained report.
modes.live: Project the latest published snapshot through the same graph and interaction contract.
modes.hub: Use the same contract within an explicit cluster scope; never merge cluster identities.

acceptance: finding or search result opens the correct topology object
Service or workload drills down through Pods, Node, and EKS infrastructure
copied URL restores view, filters, mode, and selection

slices.name: Live continuity
capabilities: revisioned graph deltas with reset semantics
stable selection, viewport, lane, and rank across accepted updates
explicit freshness and coverage without invented observations

modes.offline: Remain a complete static snapshot and label live continuity unavailable.
modes.live: Consume bounded watch and poll publications without adding topology-only API polling.
modes.hub: Accept cluster-scoped remote revisions with bounded history and reset on gaps.

acceptance: unchanged objects retain position and selection after an incremental revision
revision gaps trigger a full reset instead of applying an unsafe delta
provider absence remains unavailable through refresh

slices.name: Contextual investigation
capabilities: shared identity for findings, relatives, metrics, metadata, and raw evidence
cross-view navigation to owners, children, dependencies, and infrastructure
provider-aware metric semantics, sampling, freshness, and coverage

modes.offline: Render recorded deterministic findings and evidence with unavailable live-only metrics.
modes.live: Update fixed contextual sections from the accepted snapshot revision.
modes.hub: Keep findings and provider evidence inside the selected cluster and revision.

acceptance: selected object exposes relatives, scoped findings, metrics, and raw evidence
relative navigation changes semantic view when required and preserves selection
missing metrics and connection evidence are visibly unavailable

slices.name: Optional external evidence
capabilities: bounded metrics or observed-connection contributions to the typed graph contract
explicit provider, window, sampling, freshness, confidence, and coverage
isolated provider failure and server-side authorization

modes.offline: Accept only sanitized imported evidence that preserves provider provenance and limitations.
modes.live: Run only explicitly configured server-side providers; never expose credentials to the browser.
modes.hub: Accept attested provider evidence through the remote-writer boundary and preserve cluster scope.

acceptance: Kubernetes-only use remains complete when the provider is absent or fails
runtime edges cannot be confused with declared or inferred relationships
provider credentials and raw privileged host access never reach the browser

browserScenarios: recorded finding and search to topology to contextual evidence
local recorded-fixture delta acceptance, selection and layout continuity, and revision-gap full reset
large graph remains pannable and selectable without automatic table fallback
keyboard-only, reduced-motion, narrow viewport, light and dark theme, and screen-reader traversal
security: no privileged node workload or host-runtime access
no browser-side provider or cluster credentials
no write, terminal, delete, scale, or lifecycle controls
no cross-cluster identity, freshness, finding, or coverage leak
compatibility: existing topology entry points and static exports remain available
view, mode, filters, focus, and selected object remain URL-restorable
graph and table use the same evidence and selection state

extensionPolicy.currentSeam: typed topology graph, metric, coverage, and raw-evidence contracts with fixed UI sections
extensionPolicy.revisitWhen: two independent external evidence implementations require the same registration lifecycle
